messages.subject: Inset legend positions
parts:
Hi all -

I'm trying to set up a legend position system for the ggmap package. Since it deals with maps (that take up the entire device, in this case), the legends need to be inside the panel itself as opposed to the outside.

This can be achieved to some degree with preset legend.position options, but as you can see in the attached images, the legend - being drawn according to the aesthetic specifications - varies in height and width and, since legend.position doesn't set the position for a corner of the legend, it's not clear how I should go about positioning the legend for an arbitrary set of aesthetics.

My hope was to allow specifications such as "bottomleft", "topleft", etc. Ideas?

Thanks!
david.

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: Inset legend positions
parts:
If I understand your problem correctly, then I think legend.justification is what you're looking for:

# Put bottom-left corner of legend box in bottom-left corner of graph
opts(legend.justification=c(0,0), legend.position=c(0,0))

-Winston
